data.one_liner: Pure Dart library to render Mermaid diagrams as Flutter widgets without WebView.
data.what_it_does: It parses Mermaid syntax and renders flowcharts, sequence diagrams, charts, and other visualizations directly in Flutter. The widget adapts to screen size and supports themes and pan/zoom interactions.
use_when: You need to display Mermaid diagrams in a Flutter app without relying on a WebView or external JS engine.
You want a cross‑platform solution that works on Android, iOS, web, and desktop.
You prefer a single widget that handles many diagram types (flowchart, sequence, chart, etc.).
avoid_when: You require advanced editing or real‑time collaboration features not provided by Mermaid.
You need very large or complex diagrams that may strain Flutter’s rendering performance.
You are already using a dedicated charting library that covers your specific chart types and need more customization.
